 How many goals does Cristiano Ronaldo need to reach 1000 in his career?
 Thursday 29-10-2026 
 Mohammed Ibrahim 
 Cristiano Ronaldo, the captain of Al Nassr, is closing in on a historic milestone in his football career, having reached 985 goals, leaving him just 15 goals away from the 1000-goal mark.
 This came after his brilliant performance against Al Khulood in the Saudi league, where he scored three goals during Al Nassr's 5-2 victory, continuing to enhance his scoring record and getting closer to an exceptional number in the world of football.
 Cristiano Ronaldo scored 5 goals for Sporting Lisbon, and 145 goals during his two spells with Manchester United, while he netted 450 goals for Real Madrid, making the Spanish club the one with the largest share of his goals throughout his professional career.
 The Portuguese star has scored 101 goals with Juventus, 137 goals with Al Nassr, and 147 goals with the Portugal national team, bringing his total to 985 goals according to the reported figures.
 Cristiano Ronaldo needs to score 15 more goals to reach the milestone of 1,000 goals, an achievement eagerly awaited by football fans, as the Portuguese star continues his scoring journey with Al Nassr and his national team.
